question: Identify the antonym of "Infernal":
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Heavenly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Infernal"** means relating to or characteristic of hell or the underworld. It can also mean extremely unpleasant or annoying. (नरक का/अत्यंत कष्टदायक)
 
 
• **Example:** The infernal noise coming from the construction site made it impossible to concentrate.
 
 
• **"Heavenly"**, on the other hand, refers to something that is divine, delightful, or related to heaven. It is the opposite of "infernal". (स्वर्गीय/अत्यंत मनमोहक)
